items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: Yeah, well I wish I had known him. I could have gotten contact for you. Jasper Taylor, but Raleigh is from New Orleans.

ctx.x: That's right. Charlie Elgar gave me his name a long time ago when we were, Natty Dominic was playing some dances. Oh, is that right? And we needed a drummer because Baby Dodds wasn't so well, wasn't able to play the whole dance, so we had two drummers.
Yeah, well I wish I had known him. I could have gotten contact for you. Jasper Taylor, but Raleigh is from New Orleans. Judge Raleigh.
